name: anim_dobe_rise
subject: thick glossy pink paint goo with yellow marble streaks
desc: A flat paint puddle slowly and stickily rises: the middle bulges up into a lump, thick viscous goo stretches upward with sticky strands, the lump swells into a huge broad-chested faceless goo humanoid, the arms peel away from the sides and droop down, everything sagging and dripping heavily. No face, no ears, the head is just a smooth dripping blob.
